==Watchtower quest==
Players must use a [[magic ogre potion]] on them during the quest to kill them, because they cannot be damaged by conventional means, including [[Vengeance]], [[ring of recoil|rings of recoil]], or [[poison]].

If an ogre shaman is interacted with in any other way besides use of the potion, it will attack the player once for up to half their maximum life points of unblockable typeless damage. Protection prayers and defensive abilities do not affect the attack's damage in any way. The shamans do not re-appear after the quest is completed.
